blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Cemetery visitors joining the annual exodus on All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day on November 1 and 2 are advised to adjust their schedules. The recommendation is due to the expected afternoon rains and high heat indices forecast across Mindanao. Justine Navarro, a specialist at the state weather bureau’s Mindanao Regional Services Division, gave the information to the Inquirer on Saturday morning, October 31. Navarro predicted that localized rain showers might occur in Bukidnon, Misamis Oriental and Lanao del Sur, mostly in the afternoon and evening.
